C08-M02-L08-F1.title: The C08 lab kit as a collection pipeline
C08-M02-L08-F1.caption: How make_dataset.py, minisiem.py and normalise_demo.py map onto pipeline stages, and where the lab's health checks and fault drills attach.
C08-M02-L08-F1.alt: Graph diagram. make_dataset.py (sources + collection, fixed seed) writes banyan_events.jsonl (340 JSON lines). minisiem.py load parses each line and writes the events table in minisiem.db (12 field columns + raw). minisiem.py search queries the events table. Source-health checks (inventory, volume, silence, completeness) run through minisiem.py search. A separate branch: a Raw syslog line (firewall, local time, no year) and a Raw VPN JSON record (UTC) both go into normalise_demo.py, which outputs Normalised events with ECS-style names and UTC time. A dashed arrow from make_faults.py (outage, broken, dup copies) goes to minisiem.py load, showing that the fault drills reuse the same ingestion path.
C08-M02-L08-F1.note: Each health check measures one arrow; the fault drills test the checks through the same load path.

C08-M02-L08-F2.title: Drill A: WS-104 proxy events per hour after a simulated outage
C08-M02-L08-F2.caption: Per-host hourly volume from the outage copy of the dataset, with the two missing hours shown as zero bars against their clean-day counts.
C08-M02-L08-F2.alt: Bar chart of WS-104 proxy events per UTC hour in the outage copy: 03 UTC 3, 04 UTC 3, 05 UTC 1, 06 UTC 14 (highlighted), 07 UTC 0 (clean day 11, red), 08 UTC 0 (clean day 3, red), 09 UTC 5, 10 UTC 2, 11 UTC 5, 12 UTC 2. The load reported 326 events with no error.
